title: Alright mug.
text: Alright mug.. I expected it to be a bigger mug and it looks way better online than in person.  And I'm concerned the paint may get washed off in the dishwasher or even if hand washed.

features: HILARIOUS COFFEE MUGS: You can treat your symptoms with the world’s best medicine – coffee! This 12 oz coffee mug with clever labels prescribing coffee as a solution for every problem, is a hilarious way to start your day.

LARGE COFFEE MUGS PERFECT FOR HOME OR OFFICE: BigMouth Inc’s Prescription Bottle Coffee Mug is just what the doctor ordered. It is a perfect addition to your at-home coffee cup collection, a must have for the office, and the ideal mug for when you need a laugh.
MAKES A GREAT GIFT: This high-quality ceramic coffee mug makes a great present for any gift giving occasion and is sure to be enjoyed by any caffeine obsessed coffee drinker.

CUTE COFFEE MUGS: This unique and funny coffee cup is made of high-quality ceramic and is painted to look like a prescription bottle. After you enjoy your beverage, hand wash your coffee prescription mug and store for later. Do not microwave.

BIGMOUTH INC: We are the creative force behind an exclusive line of high-quality, fun novelty items. Our specialty is an assortment of original, humorous products targeting practical jokers of all ages
